submitted.rationale: I sampled five points across the whole Zn–Sb–O line (Sb fraction 0.24, 0.40, 0.64, 0.76 and 0.93). Every EQE was at the noise floor, between −0.0015% and 0.0011%. That fits the phases expected here, ZnSb2O6 and ZnO, which have band gaps around 3.3 eV and should not absorb 2.4 eV photons. No composition stood out. Index 25 had the highest measured value (0.00113%), but it is not really distinguishable from the others.

rejected.reason: 0.00092%, noise level; near ZnSb2O6 stoichiometry, which has a wide gap
